body: RP9 has pervasive hard collision failures that GR cannot patch. All remaining 10 cross-exam hard failures and 9 within-exam verify failures are RP9-specific. Specific violations: Q7=2, Q8=2, Q10=2 (three H-4 dupes); Q4=3, Q6=3, Q9=3 (three H-4 dupes); Q13 asymptote VA=2,HA=1 matches P2-Q13 (H-5); Q7 and Q9 collide with MVP (H-2). Plus P7-Q10 vs P9-Q10 both +-2 (H-3). GR has resolved all other hard failures (P4-Q4, P5-Q9, P6-Q7, P6-Q8, P8-Q11, P8-Q13). RP1-8 now all pass verify and cross-exam clean. Action needed: rebuild RP9 equations for Q4, Q6, Q7, Q8, Q9, Q10, Q13 with unique answer values. Target: no value 2 or 3 in any of those slots. Use FR generation brief pattern. GR is available to verify math once GA submits new equations.
